# oiioCare

> oiioCare 是用聊天记录饮食与情绪的陪伴工具（文字 / 拍照 / 语音）。想吃与已吃分开记。默认语音仅采集对话音频并转写，不用于模型训练。

oiioCare is a chat-based companion for logging food and mood. It is NOT a medical device, and does NOT diagnose, treat, or promise weight-loss outcomes.

## Product pages
- [Home](https://www.oiiocare.com/): Product overview and chat demo
- [Features](https://www.oiiocare.com/features.html): What you can do
- [FAQ](https://www.oiiocare.com/faq.html): Boundaries and privacy
- [Privacy](https://www.oiiocare.com/privacy/): Voice retention (30 days), no ambient audio, no training by default
- [About](https://www.oiiocare.com/about.html): Team / contact
